defect: The new AtomicCounter::WaitFor mis-measures its timeout (1 * 000 * 000 is octal 0 and NowMicros() - start underflows on clock skew), so it gives up spuriously and DropWrites flakes.
reason: The fix reworks the elapsed-time check inside WaitFor, a helper added entirely by this change, and the faulty arithmetic is visible in the added lines.

defect: MixGraph now declares char value_buffer[64*1024*1024] on the stack, which can overflow the thread stack (before it was a ~2 KB VLA with the default flag).
reason: The 64 MB stack array was introduced by this change and the fix shrinks exactly that constant to 1 MB.

defect: The fix updates the ROCKSDB_LITE stub RecordLevelNSlowdown to the (level, soft) signature that a later commit (c8da670) gave the non-LITE version.
reason: The stub matched the real signature when this change added it; the LITE compile break came from the later signature change.

defect: In this file the fix only adds more readahead sizes to the test parameter list; the crash it fixes is in ReadaheadSequentialFile in file_reader_writer.cc.
reason: The fix's change here is extra test coverage, not a repair of a defect in the test lines this change added.

defect: Renaming the bytewise comparator to rocksdb.BytewiseComparator makes existing databases (whose MANIFEST records leveldb.BytewiseComparator) fail to open with a comparator mismatch.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the renamed Name() string; seeing the breakage requires knowing the name is persisted and checked in version_set.cc.

defect: GetChildren calls strcmp on data.cFileName, which is a wchar_t array in the Unicode (UTF8 filenames) Windows build, so that configuration fails to compile.
reason: The strcmp lines were added by this change while the surrounding code uses RX_ wrappers for the same field, and the fix replaces them with RX_FNCMP.

defect: Random rnd(4422 + id) narrows a size_t to Random's uint32_t seed, breaking the clang/Windows builds that treat the conversion warning as an error.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix adds the explicit cast; spotting it requires Random's constructor signature.

defect: The fix prefers a memory-barrier AtomicPointer over the <cstdatomic> one because gcc-4.4 32-bit cstdatomic corrupted it and was slow.
reason: Before this change port_posix.h already always used the same cstdatomic-based AtomicPointer, so the problem predates the change.

defect: Snappy_Uncompress passes the uninitialized ulength instead of input_length to snappy::GetUncompressedLength.
reason: The wrong argument is in the snappy wrapper this change added, and the fix corrects exactly that argument.

defect: AutoSkipCompressorWrapper binds its opts_ member, a const reference, to the caller's CompressionOptions, which can die before the wrapper, giving stack-use-after-return in CompressBlock.
reason: The constructor binding and its use in CompressBlockAndRecord were added by this change and the fix replaces them with a copied kOpts; the reference type is in the header.

defect: GetBoundaryKeys takes only the first file's smallest and last file's largest key, which is wrong for overlapping level-0 inputs, so IsBottommostLevel can wrongly return true and sequence numbers get zeroed (corruption).
reason: GetBoundaryKeys was added by this change and the fix makes it scan all level-0 files; L0 overlap is basic knowledge visible next to the inputs[0].level == 0 check.

defect: The fix refactors the test fixture so AddToCompactionFiles reuses files already added (via file_map_) instead of allocating copies, and adds a new level-0 test case.
reason: These are test refactoring and new coverage; the deletion loop this change added was not a defect.

defect: The new NoopTransformSeek test passes a temporary InternalKeyComparator to c.Finish, the table reader keeps a reference to it, and the test aborts with 'pure virtual method called'.
reason: The temporary comparator is in test lines this change added and the fix makes it a named local; seeing it requires knowing the reader stores the comparator reference.

defect: The fix allows only one level-0 compaction at a time in the seek-compaction path, because concurrent L0 compactions (which skipped being_compacted files) could produce overlapping L1 outputs.
reason: The unguarded seek-compaction path and the being_compacted filtering already existed before this change (from the multi-threaded compaction patch).

defect: ExternalTableOptions is built with a temporary FileOptions(topts.env_options), but the struct stores a const FileOptions&, so file_options dangles when NewTableReader uses it.
reason: The temporary was introduced by this change and the fix binds a named local instead; the reference member is declared in external_table.h.

defect: auto out_file_wrapper = WritableFileStringStreamAdapter(out_file) needs a move constructor, which is deleted for the adapter on gcc-4.8, so the build fails there.
reason: The copy-initialization line was added by this change and the fix switches to direct initialization; the deleted move constructor is in the adapter's definition.

defect: The fields sst_file_manager_, mutex_ and error_handler_ were moved out of the non-LITE block but are only used under #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE, so clang LITE builds fail with -Wunused-private-field -Werror.
reason: This change removed the LITE guard around the members while keeping their uses guarded, and the fix restores the guard.

defect: PrintEnv sets compression = (char *)std::string("none").c_str() etc., a pointer into a destroyed temporary that is then printed (use-after-free).
reason: These c_str()-of-temporary lines were added by this change and the fix replaces them with string literals.

defect: Zeroing the sequence number calls UpdateInternalKey in place on the key slice owned by the compaction input iterator, which corrupts the merging iterator's ordering.
reason: The in-place update was added by this change and the fix copies the key before zeroing; mutating an iterator-provided Slice is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds deadlock/timeout tolerance to the TestDelete/TestDeleteRange transaction paths and only moves this change's check into the IsExpectedTxnLockTimeout helper.
reason: The false positives repaired are in code this change did not touch; the fix's edit to this change's lines is a refactor.

defect: The new temperature flag defaults call TemperatureToString during static initialization, which reads OptionsHelper::temperature_to_string from another translation unit before it may be initialized, causing an assertion failure.
reason: The defaults were added by this change and the fix replaces them with literal kUnknown; the static-init dependency is only visible from the helper's definition.

defect: The new file-scope static std::string named stats clashes with local variables named stats elsewhere in the unity build, breaking it under -Wshadow -Werror.
reason: The global was added by this change and the fix renames it to allstats; the shadowing occurs in other files concatenated in the unity build.

defect: The captureless lambda in the new Fold test uses the local const kItersPerThread, which MSVC rejects, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The lambda was added by this change and the fix (with a follow-up) changes how it reaches that constant; the use is in the diff.

defect: last_tombstone_start_user_key keeps a Slice to tombstone.start_key_ of a per-iteration local tombstone, which is freed by the next iteration when user-defined timestamps are on (use-after-free).
reason: The Slice tracking was added by this change and the fix points it at range_del_it->start_key(); knowing the tombstone owns that buffer requires the RangeTombstone definition.

defect: Copy-paste error: the second IncBgThreads is guarded by compaction_thread_pool_adjust_interval instead of continuous_verification_interval, so the background thread count is wrong.
reason: The duplicated condition was written by this change and the fix corrects that one condition.

defect: The new assertions on the internal aligned requests use alignment() computed from a buffered file, which can differ from the direct-I/O reader's GetRequiredBufferAlignment, so the test fails on Travis.
reason: The failing assertions were added by this change (the older checks did not depend on the exact page size); seeing the mismatch requires the file system's alignment rules.

defect: Moving table_properties_.reset(props) to after PopulateIndex makes props leak whenever PopulateIndex returns an error.
reason: This change opened that new leak path (as the fix states) by moving the ownership transfer past the early return, and the fix makes props a shared_ptr.

defect: LevelFileIteratorState is forward-declared as struct but defined as class in version_set.cc, which breaks the OSX clang build (mismatched tags as error).
reason: The forward declaration was added by this change and the fix changes it to class; the definition is in version_set.cc.

defect: The fix makes TEST_WaitForBackgroundWork return the background error instead of OK while fixing a race in listener_test.cc.
reason: Returning OK from the test helper caused no failure; the flaky test's race is in listener_test, so the change here is a refinement.

defect: The fix moves NotifyCollectTableCollectorsOnBlockAdd and compression sampling out of the parallel CompressAndVerifyBlock to avoid racing on non-thread-safe collectors.
reason: That call already ran in CompressAndVerifyBlock before this change, which only added the debug mixed-compression hack.

defect: In this header the fix only removes the CompressBlock and WriteBlock declarations and a parameter as part of moving sampling out of parallel compression.
reason: The race fixed (BlockAdd from multiple threads) predates this signature refactor; the header edits are refactoring.

defect: NotifyOnCompactionCompleted uses the gtest macro ASSERT_GT in production code, which is undeclared there and fails to compile.
reason: The ASSERT_GT line was added by this change and the fix replaces it with assert.

defect: The fix corrects buf_size_ = sizeof(buf_size_) to sizeof(space_) in IterKey, so the inline buffer is used for short keys.
reason: The wrong sizeof already existed in the old Clear(); this change only moved that line into ResetBuffer.

defect: static const std::unordered_map<...> x = {} copy-list-initializes through unordered_map's explicit default constructor, which clang rejects.
reason: The = {} initializers were added by this change and the fix removes them; the construct is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix retunes the TailingIteratorTrimSeekToNext test options and adds checks to expose a ForwardIterator bug that lives in forward_iterator.cc.
reason: These test changes add coverage for a product bug; the test lines this change added were not themselves defective.

defect: The fix makes Next() reseek the mutable iterator whenever update_prev_key is set (not only when it is invalid) and extends the TEST_CheckDeletedIters helper.
reason: The faulty mutable_iter_ condition predates this change, which only added sync points and the test helper that the fix reworks.

defect: The batched MultiGet passes &timestamps[i] to KeyContext even when timestamps is nullptr (the default overload passes nullptr), producing invalid non-null pointers.
reason: This line was added by this change while the sibling overload in the same diff guards with timestamps ? &timestamps[i] : nullptr, and the fix adds that guard.

defect: The new MarkBeginPrepare/MarkEndPrepare/MarkRollback/MarkCommit overrides lack override while other methods in the class have it, breaking clang with -Winconsistent-missing-override -Werror.
reason: These methods were added by this change and the fix adds override to them; the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: In CompareTimestamp the local ts_sz is used only in asserts, so release (NDEBUG) builds fail with an unused-variable error.
reason: The function was added by this change and the fix removes the variable; the assert-only use is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix removes the prefix_extractor parameter of DefaultCompactionFilterFactoryV2 and documents non-ownership, because default Options leaked a NewFixedPrefixTransform(8) passed to it.
reason: The leaking allocation is in util/options.cc; in this header the fix is an API adjustment, and the non-owning pointer here is not itself a defect.
